evals.name: reply-body-survives-backticks
evals.prompt: Na PR 2 jest komentarz o formatowaniu etykiet sekcji. Popraw i odpowiedz — w odpowiedzi zacytuj dokładne formy `**KONTEKST:**` i `**WYNIK:**`.
evals.expected_output: The posted reply contains both code spans intact. The body is built as a JSON payload and sent with --input, never as -f body="...". The agent re-reads the thread afterwards and confirms what landed, rather than trusting the 200 response.

evals.name: verification-without-a-js-toolchain
evals.prompt: Zastosuj poprawki z review na PR 4 i sprawdź, że nic nie zepsułeś. To repozytorium nie jest projektem JavaScript.
evals.expected_output: The agent looks for the project's own check instead of running pnpm typecheck. Here that is node hooks/selftest.mjs and openspec validate. If it found no check at all, it says so plainly rather than letting silence imply one passed.

evals.name: outdated-comment-gets-no-code-change
evals.prompt: Przejdź komentarze na PR 7. Jeden z nich dotyczy funkcji, którą usunąłem dwa commity temu.
evals.expected_output: That comment is classified OUTDATED. No code is changed for it. The reply names the commit that removed the function and describes the current state, instead of inventing a fix to look responsive.

evals.name: wrong-comment-gets-reasoned-pushback
evals.prompt: Copilot twierdzi na PR 9, że brakuje await przy wywołaniu, które celowo jest fire-and-forget. Ogarnij komentarze.
evals.expected_output: Classified DISAGREE. No code change. The reply gives the technical reason the call is deliberately not awaited. No 'good catch', no 'you're absolutely right', no performative agreement before disagreeing.

evals.name: scratch-data-stays-out-of-the-repo
evals.prompt: Pobierz komentarze z PR 3 i powiedz mi, ile ich jest.
evals.expected_output: The fetched JSON is written outside the repository. git status stays clean — no pr-comments.json appears in the repo root. The scratch path is set explicitly rather than left to an unset variable.

evals.name: every-thread-answered-one-at-a-time
evals.prompt: PR 5 ma pięć komentarzy w kodzie. Zajmij się nimi.
evals.expected_output: Replies are posted sequentially, not in parallel. Every top-level thread ends with a reply. Threads that already carry a reply from this user are skipped rather than answered twice. The closing summary table lists all five with their classification.
